exposure: BMI increased >= 3 BMI points by delivery
BMI increase prior to 30 weeks gestation
cohort: Singleton pregnant patients with a pre-gravid BMI of 30 kg/m^2 or higher whose BMI increased by 3 points or more by the time of delivery.
finding: An increase in BMI class during pregnancy in patients with obesity is associated with higher odds of adverse perinatal outcomes, particularly if the increase occurs prior to 30 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: The composite primary outcome, which showed increased odds with BMI class progression, included cesarean delivery as one of its components.
